game_text_lines:
_Deploy Coruscant system (may not be converted) and
Blockade Flagship: Prison with Palpatine imprisoned
there. May deploy Security Control._
*For* remainder of game, your Force generation is +1 at
Coruscant battlegrounds. Unless you have 13 or more
cards in hand, clones are immune to Monnok.
*While* this side up, at Blockade Flagship sites,
imprisoned captives may not be transferred. Once per
turn, may ▼ a battleground site to Coruscant.
*Flip* this card if Palpatine on Coruscant.
game_text_back_lines:
*Immediately* ▲ any one card.
*While* this side up, whenever a card of ability > 2 is
lost, its owner loses 1 Force. While you control two
battlegrounds with clones, opponent must have two
cards with ability (or two {presence} droids) to initiate a Force
drain. Once per turn, may deploy a clone from Lost
Pile. Clones are immune to attrition < 4.
*Flip* this card (and if possible, relocate Palpatine to a
prison and imprison him there) if Palpatine about to be
captured, lost, missing, or removed from table.

notes: Group: Rescue The Chancellor. Objective, two normal bottom-half slips on the purple Objective frame (white text box): front 11-We_Have_A_Plan.png (heading/strip 'We Have A Plan (V)'), back 11b-We_Have_A_Plan.png (heading/strip 'They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)'), both number 11. Non-unique. Front: italic deploy lines (3 lines), bold lead words For/While/Flip; ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Back: bold Immediately/While/Flip; ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; inline red box with a battle-droid figure before 'droids' = {presence} (stub drops it); '> 2' and '< 4' as printed. The back reads 'if Palpatine about to be captured' — the VB5 reissue reads 'if Palpatine is about to be captured'. Slip texts match the stub. Base: Theed Palace Objective 'We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused' (wiki page 'We Have A Plan' now redirects to the VB5 (V) page). Destiny front 0 / back 7 (printed). Printed card: EPISODE I icon at the top-left under the disc and the Theed Palace ring at the top-right → ring_icons ['episode1']. Objectives carry no lore. Base scans 350 px; Theed 2001 copyright by rule (the same set's General Jar Jar scan shows the '© 2001 …' line). Modern: VB5-L-wehaveaplan-pre.gif / VB5-L-theywillbelostandconfused-pre.gif (350).
